observations: Lamotrigine altered 14 genes in primary rat hippocampal cells and increased GABA-A receptor beta3 expression, but no direct REST/NRSF measurement or REST-target enrichment was identified.
Lamotrigine participated in a shared astrocytic FEZ1 induction signature with three other mood stabilisers.

entities.name: FEZ1
observations: FEZ1 was the only gene commonly induced by lithium, valproic acid, carbamazepine, and lamotrigine in human astrocyte-derived cells; induction was validated at RNA and protein levels.
The shared FEZ1 response was not shown to be REST/NRSF-mediated.

entities.name: SIX1
observations: Six1 showed up to 31.3-fold induction in a broad lithium/valproate SH-SY5Y microarray study and was mechanistically linked to anti-apoptotic protection; REST/NRSF was not established as its mediator.

entities.name: PMID:18671961
observations: Lithium-induced suppression of transcription repressor NRSF/REST was reported in rat embryonic neural stem cells under ethanol-induced differentiation impairment.

entities.name: PMID:25451397
observations: Mood-stabiliser-regulated genes in human SH-SY5Y cells showed transcriptional-network enrichment implicating NRSF/REST; this was an indirect inference.
